title: Duplicate orders
summary: Some customers are charged two, three, four times for one order, while the app tells them checkout failed.
alert: [FIRING] DuplicateCharges: PayFlow flagged possible duplicate charges in the last 10 minutes

questions.prompt: Where do the extra orders come from?

choices.label: The app retries checkouts that take too long, and every attempt places an order
Customers tap the checkout button twice
The API writes each order twice
PayFlow charges cards twice on its own
The edge proxy retries requests to the API

questions.prompt: Why does a retried checkout become a new order, and a new charge?

choices.label: The API ignores the Idempotency-Key the app sends, and gives PayFlow a new key for every attempt
The app sends a new Idempotency-Key with every attempt
Orders aren't written in a transaction

questions.prompt: Why does it only happen to some customers?

choices.label: Their bank takes longer to authorize the card than the app waits
They still use an old version of the app
They're far from ShopFlow's data center

slos.label: Duplicate orders
slos.query: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= $start AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders p WHERE p.customer_id = o.customer_id AND p.total_cents = o.total_cents AND p.id < o.id AND p.created_at > o.created_at - interval '1 minute')

slos.label: Checkouts the app gives up on
